purpose: Enforce the source rejection of an invalid historical mnemonic metric whose denominator is identically zero, without reconstructing or repairing the rejected formula.

required.statement: Preserve that the historical metric is invalid because it divides by ||X-X||=0 and is not retained as a valid metric.

forbidden.statement: Do not reconstruct the historical formula, replace its denominator, repair it, calculate it, or publish it as executable.

deferred.statement: No valid mnemonic-efficiency formula is supplied by this chapter.

operations.purpose: Reject any request to resurrect, repair, reconstruct, or execute the invalid mnemonic metric.

inputs.name: mnemonic_metric_request
inputs.semantic_role: Proposed use or reconstruction of the rejected source metric

outputs.name: exclusion_status
outputs.semantic_role: Descriptor stating that the source metric is invalid and excluded

postconditions.statement: The rejected metric never becomes a valid executable feature.

invariants.statement: Only the explicit invalidity basis ||X-X||=0 is preserved; no missing formula terms are synthesized.

steps: reject reconstruction repair denominator replacement and execution

error_contract.condition: Calculation, reconstruction, repair, denominator replacement, or executable publication of the invalid metric is requested.

implementation_modes.statement: Expose only the scientific exclusion; no metric evaluator exists.

global_invariants.statement: The invalid mnemonic expression is never repaired into a new formula.

notes: This package deliberately contains no mnemonic-efficiency calculation.
